items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You say you knew Lawrence too, huh, and his brothers? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Simon.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I mean, was he good?

Was he good? Yeah, he was one of the wonderful. He the one played with, he used to play with, uh, he played with, uh, with Manuel Wilde, but his daddy was the main man with him. His dad was with Manuel, with him though, Simon's daddy. He used to call him Bill Moray. He was short, fella. He was like Lawrence. He called him Bill Moray.
He was short too, I know him.
